prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TRANSPARENT PNG 2D game equipment and effects sprite atlas, exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels.
Primary request: precisely eight independent complete cartoon equipment/effect sprites, arranged in a strict 4-column by 2-row grid, one item centered in each equal 384 x 512 pixel cell. REAL TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND WITH ALPHA CHANNEL and genuinely empty transparent gutters. Do not paint a background or checkerboard.
Style: rich hand-painted animated storybook cartoon sprites with thick clean dark-plum outlines, saturated warm colours, rounded exaggerated forms and soft painterly shading. Match equipment for a cream-coloured cartoon pony with orange mane, teal helmet and plum outlines. Crisp readable shapes, polished funny physics game. Objects only, no pony or wearer.
Row 1, left to right:
1. A small strapped red jetpack with two stubby rocket canisters and a warm yellow-orange flame pointed downward. Side-three-quarter view; compact backpack with visible strap loops, no wearer.
2. A symmetrical pair of fluffy white feathered angel wings, spread wide with a small transparent gap between their bases; ivory shading, plum outlines. Wings only, no body.
3. A coral pink party-cone hat with tiny teal and cream dots and a soft cream pompom, tilted slightly right, no head.
4. A chunky shiny gold crown with three broad rounded points and small coral gems, side-three-quarter view, no head.
Row 2, left to right:
5. A turquoise clear astronaut helmet bubble with thick teal collar at its bottom, rounded transparent glass with subtle sky-blue edge highlights; empty transparent space through the glass center, no head.
6. A purple glowing magnetic horseshoe, open ends upward, with bright lilac tips and just a few tiny restrained magnetic sparks close to its silhouette.
7. A compact green bean-propulsion cloud, three connected rounded green gas puffs forming a left-to-right directional trail, a few tiny green bean shapes nestled in the cloud. Playful cartoon motion effect.
8. A purple ghost portal ring, upright elliptical circle with a bright lilac inner rim, translucent swirling wisps confined tightly around the rim and an entirely transparent hollow center.
Layout: each complete item MUST fit in its own 384 x 512 cell with at least 45 pixels of completely transparent margin around all four cell edges, including any glow or flame. Scale down wide items to fit. Keep the 4 columns perfectly separate, do not fill the gutters. No two objects overlap, no cell borders or labels.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, no opaque background, no coloured backdrop, no background gradient, no checkerboard, no floor, no cast ground shadows, no text, no lettering, no UI, no watermark, no extra props, no pony, no people. Preserve clear transparent holes in horseshoe, helmet and portal.
